scope:
Create a compact review receipt; reconcile executed full objects with Make.

All input receipts remain reproducible from the neighboring tools. This report
does not turn synthetic phase counts, perfect-D cycles or demand addresses
into measured console cache misses or frame-time results.

native.scope:
Price complete public native UI emit functions with typed unchanged edges.

Production ui_draw_quad/glyph code and begin_pvr_packet execute unchanged.
Cached headers contain all eight defined seeded words. The metadata lookup
edge supplies a real Texture and live Header; stream_send is an observed,
zero-cost transport edge. Actual transport, allocation, upload and GPU costs
are excluded. Scalar RN/DN execution is bounded fixture evidence, not general
hardware FP conformance. Demand lines are touches, never measured misses.

bridge.scope:
Price full compiled public re4dc_draw_id_quad with fixed typed service edges.

The fixture observes all 104 output bytes and mask submissions. Inputs use the
actual target IdUnit/TPL/GX layouts. The bridge's arithmetic executes normally;
the unchanged matrix edge is an identity-screen copy, and texture/camera/native
enqueue services use typed adapters. Adapter instructions are retained, their
original game/service costs are not claimed. Normal RN/DN scalar arithmetic
and bounded finite color conversions only; no hardware frame-time prediction.

camera.scope:
Run complete compiled messageCamera and unchanged production math/GX code.

OFF constructor and ON immutable template are compared in all 16 matrix words
at GXSetProjection entry and all seven resulting compact GX state words.
Only observable GX state must match: removed GX identity-load/current-matrix
calls are actual no-op functions in gx_stub.cpp. FP exception status is outside
the scalar interpreter; the compile-time template is qualified for normal RN.
